mentions.name: Dozenal
mentions.description: A number puzzle game with daily challenges where players combine different mathematical operations to fill a grid with "12"s. Currently an MVP seeking feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt: My friend and I have been working on a game: Dozenal. It’s a number puzzle game (with daily challenges) where you have to combine different mathematical operations to fill a grid with “12”s.
